title: Beyond Arrow: From Impossibility to Possibility in Multi-Criteria Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2602.07593v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern benchmarks such as HELM MMLU account for multiple metrics like accuracy, robustness and efficiency. When trying to turn these metrics into a single ranking, natural aggregation procedures can produce cyclic pairwise comparisons or rankings that are unstable to changes in the model set. We formalize this aggregation as a social choice problem where each metric induces a preference ranking over models on each dataset, and a benchmark operator aggregates these votes across metrics. While prior work has focused on Arrow's impossibility result, we identify sufficient conditions under which the impossibility disappears and meaningful multi-criteria benchmarking becomes possible. translated_title: 超越阿罗：多准则基准测试中从不可能到可能
translated_abstract: 现代基准测试（如 HELM、MMLU）需要考虑准确率、鲁棒性和效率等多个指标。当试图将这些指标汇总为单一排名时，自然的聚合程序可能产生循环的两两比较，或对模型集合变化不稳定的排名。我们将这种聚合形式化为一个社会选择问题：每个指标在每个数据集上诱导出对模型的偏好排名，而基准测试算子则跨指标聚合这些投票。虽然先前的工作主要聚焦于阿罗不可能定理，我们识别出了不可能性消失的充分条件，从而使有意义的多准则基准测试成为可能。特别是，我们研究了排名组合上的三种限制，并证明在单峰、群可分和距离受限的偏好下，基准测试算子能够构建出性质良好的相关模型排名。
tldr: 该论文突破了阿罗不可能定理对多准则基准排序的限制，识别出单峰、群可分和距离受限三类偏好结构，在这些条件下多指标基准测试可以产生稳定且有意义的大模型排名。
en_tdlr: This paper moves beyond Arrow's impossibility theorem by identifying three sufficient preference structures—single-peaked, group-separable, and distance-restricted preferences—under which multi-criteria benchmarking can produce stable and meaningful rankings of models.
